rows.market_wrap: Nifty fell 1.75% to 25,350 (Sensex −1,484 points) after a gap-up open reversed into broad selling. Profit-taking after a strong November rally, a roughly 93% market-implied chance of a December US Fed rate rise, a rupee near 93 per dollar and the global AI-stock sell-off weighed; banks and metals led the fall, with Tata Steel down about 8.5% on its APL Apollo deal, while IT stocks rose.
